title: Practice 7: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: С конторки и кресел сгрёб ворох бумаг и ___ (натаскать — to carry or drag) их кипами из шкафов.
exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  From Михаил Булгаков, «Ханский огонь».
